subject: Aids to Navigation - Lake Erie - Port Colborne
text:
Aids to Navigation - Lake Erie - Port Colborne
Privately maintained orange and white mooring buoy with flashing amber light and radar reflector placed for the navigational season to mark the shipwreck "Raleigh" at 42 51.926N 079 09.247W.
    Aids: 
                Raleigh mooring buoy RALE
